lines.zh: 我抱着一捆炸药，走得很小心。
lines.en: Carrying a bundle of blasting charges, I step carefully.

lines.zh: 护目镜蒙了灰，我看不太清。
lines.en: My goggles are dusty and I can't see well.
I chalk lines on the ground as I walk.

lines.zh: 我绕开自己上次炸出的坑。
lines.en: I skirt the crater from my last attempt.
The wrench on my belt clinks.

lines.zh: 我数着步子，量引线的长度。
lines.en: I count paces to gauge the fuse.

lines.zh: 我退着走，眼睛盯着那堆东西。
lines.en: I walk backward, eyes on the pile.

lines.zh: 我踩着碎石过去，鞋底薄。
lines.en: I cross the gravel; my soles are thin.

lines.zh: 我往工棚走，那儿有图纸。
lines.en: I head to the shed where the plans are.

lines.zh: 我步子迈得小，怕颠着引信。
lines.en: Short steps, so the fuse doesn't jostle.
I move upwind where there's less smoke.

lines.zh: 我在努力不把自己炸到。
lines.en: I'm trying not to blow myself up.

lines.zh: 我停下，回头看了看引线。
lines.en: I stop and look back at the fuse.
I talk to myself the whole way.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，往铁管里塞火药。
lines.en: I squat and pack powder into an iron pipe.

lines.zh: 我数了三遍引信的长度。
lines.en: I've measured the fuse three times.
My fingers are black with soot.

lines.zh: 我把图纸翻过来又翻回去。
lines.en: I flip the plans over and back.

lines.zh: 我咬着一根钉子，想别的事。
lines.en: I chew a nail and think about something else.

lines.zh: 远处有嗡嗡声，是我的小无人机。
lines.en: A hum in the distance. My little drone.
I'm working out how much powder is enough.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖袖子，掉出些灰。
lines.en: I shake my sleeve and ash falls out.
My eyebrows are permanently singed.

lines.zh: 我把两个零件对比着看。
lines.en: I hold two parts up against each other.

lines.zh: 铁砧上还留着上次的凹痕。
lines.en: The anvil still has last time's dent.
I scratch my head. All grease.

lines.zh: 你别站那儿，我要试爆了。
lines.en: Don't stand there. I'm about to test it.
Have you come to help too?
Want to borrow my goggles?
Stand back. Ten paces at least.

lines.zh: 你脚步别太重，地上有引线。
lines.en: Don't step heavily. There's a fuse on the ground.
I'll count to three. Cover your ears.
I think this design will work.

lines.zh: 上次也这么说，结果炸了。
lines.en: I said that last time and it blew up.
Don't touch the red one.
I'm improving it. Truly.
Ouch. My fingers again.
I clutch my arm and hop.
My powder's still on me.
Lighter than the last one.
I cough up a mouthful of ash.

lines.zh: 我坐在地上，好一会儿没动。
lines.en: I sit on the ground and don't move a while.
I broke this leg once before.
One lens of my goggles is cracked.
Blood's running into my eye.
I can keep working. Don't stop me.
Where did you get that powder?
This is better than mine.
Let me see how long the fuse is.
My eyes have gone wide.
This would fit my new pipe.
Don't carry it that close.
I'm reaching. Don't pull back.

lines.zh: 有了这个，能炸开半面墙。
lines.en: With this I could open half a wall.
I'll take it and test it later.
I've hunted this material a long while.
Careful! I'm carrying powder.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我冷汗都出来了。
lines.en: That bump brought out a cold sweat.

lines.zh: 我赶紧摸了摸引信还在不在。
lines.en: I check at once that the fuse is still there.
Don't push me. My hands are never steady.
You knocked my goggles off.
Back off. There's something at my feet.
I steady the crate and set it down slowly.
That nearly went wrong.
Watch the ground when you walk.
No harm. Nothing went off.

lines.zh: 我这人身上总有火药味。
lines.en: I always smell of powder.
Wait until I finish this test.

lines.zh: 你会画图纸吗？那太好了。
lines.en: Can you draw plans? Excellent.

lines.zh: 我的眉毛是自己烧掉的。
lines.en: My eyebrows I burned off myself.

lines.zh: 跟我在一起，耳朵要受罪。
lines.en: With me, your ears will suffer.

lines.zh: 我造了台小无人机，它替我看伤。
lines.en: I built a little drone. It watches for my wounds.

lines.zh: 别嫌我脏，我修东西的手是干净的。
lines.en: Don't mind the grime. My hands are clean when they work.

lines.zh: 我们一起把这条矿道炸开。
lines.en: Let's blast this tunnel open together.

lines.zh: 你站我旁边，我心里踏实。
lines.en: With you beside me I feel steadier.

lines.zh: 等这村庄通了电，我们再谈。
lines.en: Once this village has power, we'll talk.
This scrap of iron will do nicely.
I pick it up and stuff it in my tool bag.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的钉子，我一枚枚捡。
lines.en: I pick up every fallen nail.
This length of fuse is still good.
My fingers are too thick; I drop it twice.
This has some weight to it.
Up to the light — the fuse looks intact.
It fell in the pit and I can't reach.
Keep it. It might be repurposed.
I'll have a use for this.
I already trimmed the fuse.

lines.zh: 我手里的东西还没固定。
lines.en: What I'm holding isn't secured yet.
Hold still while I look.

lines.zh: 地上这根线你看得见吗？
lines.en: Can you see the line on the ground?

lines.zh: 我三步就能退到掩体后面。
lines.en: Three steps and I'm behind cover.
Counting down. This time it'll be accurate.
You're on my test ground.
I need to talk you out of there first.
I know this distance.
Trigger pulled. The fuse is hissing.

lines.zh: 我把箱子慢慢放到地上。
lines.en: I lower the crate carefully to the ground.

lines.zh: 我在心里把步骤重排了一遍。
lines.en: I run the steps through my head again.

lines.zh: 你最好现在就离开这块地。
lines.en: You'd better clear this ground now.

lines.zh: 我把引线又检查了一遍。
lines.en: I check the fuse one more time.
I reach for my tinder stick.

lines.zh: 引线在冒烟，你还有十秒。
lines.en: The fuse is smoking. Ten seconds.

lines.zh: 我退到石头后面，只露头。
lines.en: I get behind the rock and show only my head.

lines.zh: 你脚下的那块石头是松的。
lines.en: That stone under your feet is loose.
Counting: five, four, three.
I've got the charge right this time.

lines.zh: 别往左跑，那边是弹药箱。
lines.en: Don't run left. The ammo crate is there.
I pull my goggles down.
I watch the sparks on the fuse.
Nearly. Just a moment.
You'd better cover your ears.
There. It's done.
At one I light it.
I'm backing five paces. Don't follow.
You'd best crouch.
I swing the wrench at your knee.
I throw a charge wide.

lines.zh: 这一下不是打你，是吓你。
lines.en: That wasn't to hit you. It was to warn you.

lines.zh: 我推你一把，让你离开那儿。
lines.en: I shove you clear of that spot.
My hammer's small. It won't hit hard.
I lob a small bomb.
It went off and the smoke has me coughing.
I get caught in my own blasts often.
Back off. Perfect - just at the blast edge.
Don't go near that pile.
I back away hugging the crate.
That should keep you at a distance.

lines.zh: 我从工棚里钻出来，满脸灰。
lines.en: I crawl out of the shed covered in soot.

lines.zh: 这片空地，正好做试验场。
lines.en: This clearing will make a good test ground.
I set the toolbox at my feet.

lines.zh: 村庄的科技，得有人推一把。
lines.en: Someone has to push this village's technology.
First I plant the markers.

lines.zh: 火药的味道，闻着就踏实。
lines.en: The smell of powder puts me at ease.

lines.zh: 我咳了两声，把烟清出去。
lines.en: I cough twice to clear the smoke.

lines.zh: 这次我画了更长的引线。
lines.en: This time I drew a longer fuse.
I forgot to wipe my goggles again.

lines.zh: 我想试试能不能炸开那道墙。
lines.en: I want to see if I can open that wall.
I send the drone out.
Right. Starting from this step.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我腰上的药就危险。
lines.en: Fire threatens the powder at my belt.

lines.zh: 我从架子上摔下来，砸在工具上。
lines.en: I fall off the scaffold onto the tools.

lines.zh: 水一进引信，我整个人都凉了。
lines.en: Water reaches the fuse and I go cold.

lines.zh: 是我自己的药吗？我不确定。
lines.en: Was that my powder? I can't tell.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过我的护目镜。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my goggles.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的引线烧了。
lines.en: That force burns my fuse away.
Hungry, I can't lift the crate.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我身上的药全完了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my powder is ruined.
No air. The fire will not catch.
